proof_qualifications: Browser cases render synthetic pages through the actual renderer/template/controller with controlled auth and HTTP; they do not browse the saved production-input HTML/JSON pair. Served-file hashes identify that pair only.
Nine parametrized tests invoke actual builder.render, render_html and real public/protected file writers in isolated temporary roots, with the real writer shim flag restored by pytest monkeypatch.
Overwrite proof covers successful render, not crash-atomic publication or failures before the protected write.
The changed-generation fixture changes recipe legs and protected identity at the same source clock; it is not a recipe-only isolation experiment.
The protocol fence blocks subsequent incompatible hydration. It cannot evict names already painted by an old reader before the transition.

The public/protected current-input pair is byte-conserved except for two HTML protocol projections and the one JSON schema field; its protected JSON equals the actual producer. Rendered HTML inverse comparison fixes only the page-generation clock for that comparison.
Four action-card crops are visually inspected. No whole-page production, account entitlement, CDN, or deployment proof is claimed.
